selection_reason: APM-04 completed_verified in PR #435. CSW-02, CSW-04 and CSW-06 satisfy CSW-07 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects CSW-07 next while the requested four-tranche run stops before CSW-07 substantive work.
objective: Define a Writing Studio and Revision Workspace for longform and shortform creator prose with recoverable autosave/history, branches and comparison, Story Bible fact/reference support, outline/fragment-to-draft flows, governed-object links, export/handout boundaries and explicit optional-assistance apply/reject behavior while keeping writer-authored prose, creative possibility and governed facts semantically distinct.
completion_gate: Creators can draft and revise prose with recoverable history, branches/comparison and authorized factual/context support while retaining control over every accepted change and without prose notes silently becoming governed Campaign/World/Adventure truth.
required_design_questions: What durable document/draft/revision model supports longform and shortform writing without duplicating governed object truth?
How do autosave, checkpoints, explicit versions, branches and comparison work together without destructive overwrite?
How do outline-to-draft and fragment-to-draft flows preserve source provenance and independent source identity?
How are Story Bible/governed references shown beside prose while distinguishing governed fact, creator note and speculative material?
How are linked governed objects referenced without embedding stale duplicate truth into prose?
What writing surfaces are required for backstories, lore, descriptions, scene text, handouts, rumors, letters, journals, summaries, pitches and GM notes?
How do terminology/style/voice notes remain reusable creator guidance rather than rigid correctness rules?
How do optional expand/shorten/rephrase/tone/clarity suggestions preserve factual constraints and require compare/apply/reject?
How are exports, print/handout projections and visibility/redaction boundaries governed?
How do collaborative conflicts, offline edits, recovery and stale-reference changes behave?
What accessibility/mobile/nonvisual editing and revision-comparison behavior is required?
How does CSW-06 continuity evidence surface beside writing without auto-correcting text?
next_action: Execute CSW-07 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining writing document/revision identity, autosave/history/branching/comparison, Story Bible/reference support, draft transforms, governed links, export/handout boundaries, optional assistance and accessibility/recovery contracts.
